questions.text: What primary genetic difference distinguishes PKD1 from PKD2 mutations in ADPKD?

options.A: PKD1 (chr 16, polycystin-1, 85%) causes earlier ESRD (~53y); PKD2 (chr 4, polycystin-2, 15%) has later ESRD (~70y)
options.B: PKD1 is on chr 4 encoding polycystin-2; PKD2 is on chr 16
options.C: PKD1 cysts are restricted strictly to liver; PKD2 affects kidneys only
options.D: PKD1 is X-linked dominant; PKD2 is autosomal recessive
options.E: Both mutations have identical clinical onset and cause ESRD by age 20
